_readme: Each entry is one confirmed Hijri month start (a moon-sighting anchor), all dates in dd/mm/yyyy format. hijriDate is the 1st of that Hijri month (day is always 01, e.g. 01/04/1448 means 1 Rabi-us-Saani 1448 -- month numbers run 01 Muharram to 12 Zulhujjah). gregStart is the Gregorian date that month began on. lastUpdated is when this entry was confirmed or added. link is an optional Islamic Foundation Bangladesh announcement URL (leave as an empty string if none). Add a new entry here whenever a new month is confirmed; NEVER edit or delete an old entry's gregStart just because a newer month was announced. Each month keeps its own confirmed date permanently, which is what lets the calendar stay accurate for past months even when a later month's sighting didn't land exactly where the standard 30/29-day pattern would have predicted. Order in this array does not matter -- the app sorts anchors itself -- so feel free to keep newest first for your own convenience.
